tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs/

na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /rje btsun klu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /mnga' bdag bi su kalpa dang*/ / grub chen sa ra ha pa la/ /gsol ba =/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs/ /de sras thu bo zla ba grags/ /grub mchog slob pa'i rdo rje la/ /gsol ba=/ /brtul zhugs mchog spyod nag po pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug sprin shugs can/ /sgra bsgyur 'gos lo chen po la/ gsol ba=/ /rgyal sras sed+ge rgyal mtshan dang*/ / rim gnyis mngon gyur ye shes seng*/ /mkhas mchog ā r+ya de ba la/ /gsol ba=/ /rgyun don gsal mdzad nyi ma lcam/ /zab don mngon gyur rin chen grags/ /mchog brnyes tshul khrims skyabs nyid la/ /gsol ba=/ / mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa skyabs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin gzhon nu 'od/ /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la/ /gsol =/ /nus pa phul phyin 'phags pa 'od/ /rje btsun bu ston rin chen grub/ /mkhas grub bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba=/ /sgra bsgyur chen po nam mkha' bzang*/ /mnyam med rje btsun red mda' ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha par/ /gsol ba=/ /smra ba'i nyi ma mkhas grub rjes/ /'dus pa'i bka' babs sher seng sogs/ /lam 'di'i dngos brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba=/ /de ltar gsol pa btab pa'i mthus/ /skye ba kun du rjes bzung ste/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /go 'phang mchog de myur thob shog /ces gsang ba 'dus pa'i bla brgyud rim pa gnyis las rgyal sras blo gros rin chen nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'don pa da lta dar che yang*/ phyag na rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs phyogs 'dir ma dar 'dug pas/ de dar snyam du bsams te bshad sgrub ming can gyis bris pa'o/ mad+ga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/
co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/phyag na rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/ -PAGE 368--PAGE 647--PAGE 367-
